[[File:Coronet_Durasteel_Official.png|thumb|right|224px|A Coronet Durasteel official]]
'''Coronet Durasteel''' was a company represented by an official in [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. When the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Battle of Corellia|invaded]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Coronet Durasteel was quick to ally itself with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Coronet Spaceport" />

Other [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] companies did not yield to the [[Politics/Legends|Empire]], however, and despite Coronet Durasteel's efforts to persuade them otherwise in a bid to appease their Imperial overseers, companies such as<ref name="Coronet Spaceport" /> [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corellia]], the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]],<ref name="Corporate Warfare">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Corporate Warfare|Corellia}}</ref> and [[Corellia StarDrive]]<ref name="StarDrive Combustion">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|StarDrive Combustion|Corellia}}</ref> did not fall to Imperial persuasion<ref name="Coronet Spaceport" /> until resistance was crushed by Imperial forces coordinated by [[Darth Charnus]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Darth Decimus]], who was leader of the Imperial occupation.<ref name="Corporate Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coronet Durasteel was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The company shares its name with [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]]<ref name="Coronet Spaceport" /> and [[Coronet City/Legends|City]],<ref name="Coronet City">{{TORcite|type=location|Coronet City|Corellia}}</ref> as well as [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], a material used to produce [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="History of Mandalorian Armor">{{SW|url=news/the-history-of-mandalorian-armor|text=The History of Mandalorian Armor|int=The History of Mandalorian Armor|nolive=1}}</ref>
